# pwa-shell

pwa option on runProdApp and the dev server: web manifest, generated service worker with an offline app shell and a one-time install hint.

## README

# PWA shell

Make the web app installable and keep its shell available offline with one `pwa`
option. Pass the same object to `runProdApp` and to the dev server (`runDevApp` or
`createKumikoServer`); without it nothing changes and no service worker is registered.

## What it shows

- **Manifest**: `GET /manifest.webmanifest` is built from `name`, `shortName`,
  `themeColor`, `backgroundColor` and `icons` (`display: standalone`, scope `/`).
  `/manifest.json` stays the hashed-asset map that `kumiko build` writes.
- **Head tags**: every HTML shell gets the manifest link, `theme-color`, the Apple
  home-screen tags, an `apple-touch-icon` (largest icon that is not maskable) and
  `<meta name="kumiko-pwa-sw">`. The web client registers the worker only when that
  meta is present.
- **Service worker**: `GET /sw.js` is generated by the server, no build step and no
  external library. It precaches `/`, the manifest, the icons and the hashed bundles,
  serves `/assets/*` cache-first, goes to the network first for navigations and falls
  back to the cached shell only when offline. `/api/`, `/sse/`, `/auth/`, SSE streams,
  non-GET and cross-origin requests never touch the cache. A new build gets a new
  cache name and the old cache is dropped on activate.
- **Install hint**: a one-time banner. iOS explains Share and "Add to Home Screen",
  other browsers get an Install button behind `beforeinstallprompt`. "Not now" is
  remembered in `localStorage`; standalone launches never show it.

Icons must be same-origin paths (`/icons/...`) served from `public/` in dev and
`dist/` in production; the boot rejects anything else. The default CSP
(`default-src 'self'`) already allows the manifest and the worker.

## Flow

1. `src/app.ts` defines the feature and the `pwa` option.
2. `bin/server.ts` passes both to `runProdApp` with `staticDir: "dist"`.
3. The test boots the dev server with the same option and checks the shell tags,
   the manifest and the generated worker over HTTP.

## Run

```bash
bun kumiko test all samples/recipes/pwa-shell/
```

## Source files

### bin/server.ts

```ts
import { composeEnvSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/env";
import { runProdApp } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime";
import { notesFeature, pwa } from "../src/app";

const features = [notesFeature];

await runProdApp({
  features,
  envSchema: composeEnvSchema({ features }),
  staticDir: "dist",
  pwa,
});
```

### src/__tests__/pwa-shell.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createKumikoServer, type KumikoServerHandle } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server";
import { notesFeature, pwa } from "../app";

let handle: KumikoServerHandle;

beforeAll(async () => {
  handle = await createKumikoServer({
    features: [notesFeature],
    port: 0,
    installSignalHandlers: false,
    pwa,
  });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await handle.stop();
});

const get = (path: string) => handle.fetch(new Request(`http://localhost${path}`));

describe("pwa-shell recipe", () => {
  test("every app route serves the shell with manifest, theme color and worker meta", async () => {
    const html = await (await get("/notes/42")).text();
    expect(html).toContain('<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest" />');
    expect(html).toContain('<meta name="theme-color" content="#14532d" />');
    expect(html).toContain('<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/icons/icon-512.png" />');
    expect(html).toContain('<meta name="kumiko-pwa-sw" content="/sw.js" />');
  });

  test("the manifest is built from the option", async () => {
    const res = await get("/manifest.webmanifest");
    expect(res.headers.get("content-type")).toBe("application/manifest+json");
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({
      name: "Field Notes",
      short_name: "Notes",
      display: "standalone",
      start_url: "/",
    });
  });

  test("the worker is generated by the server and keeps /api out of its cache", async () => {
    const res = await get("/sw.js");
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-cache");
    const script = await res.text();
    expect(script).toContain("kumiko-pwa-");
    expect(script).toContain('"/api/"');
  });
});
```

### src/app.ts

```ts
import { createEntity, createTextField, defineFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import type { PwaOptions } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/pwa";

const noteEntity = createEntity({
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
  },
  table: "pwa_shell_note",
});

export const notesFeature = defineFeature("pwa-notes", (r) => {
  r.entity({ name: "note", ...noteEntity });
});

// Icons live in public/ (dist/ after kumiko build); the boot rejects any src that is not a
// same-origin path.
export const pwa: PwaOptions = {
  name: "Field Notes",
  shortName: "Notes",
  themeColor: "#14532d",
  backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
  icons: [
    { src: "/icons/icon-192.png", sizes: "192x192", type: "image/png" },
    { src: "/icons/icon-512.png", sizes: "512x512", type: "image/png" },
    {
      src: "/icons/icon-maskable-512.png",
      sizes: "512x512",
      type: "image/png",
      purpose: "maskable",
    },
  ],
};
```
